tha-ap19:1.1: Rāhuḷatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. [17. Upasena {Vaṅgantaputta}.] Padumuttaraṃ bhagavantaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ / pabbhāramhi nisinnaṃ taṃ upagañchiṃ naruttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap19:2.1: Kaṇikā*raṃ pupphitaṃ disvā vaṇṭaṃ chetvān' ahaṃ tadā / alaṅkaritvā chattamhi Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap19:3.1: Piṇḍapātañ ca pādāsiṃ paramannaṃ subhojanaṃ / Buddhena navame tattha samaṇe aṭṭha bhojayiṃ. // //
tha-ap19:4.1: Anumodi mahāvīro sayambhū aggapuggalo: / *"Iminā chattadā*nena paramannappavecchanā. // //
tha-ap19:5.1: Tena cittappasādena sampattim anubhossati / tiṃsakhattun ca devindo devarajjaṃ karissati. // //
tha-ap19:6.1: Ekavīsatikhattuñ ca cakkavatti bhavissati / padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ
tha-ap19:10.1: Carimaṃ vat*tate mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe sa*mūhatā / dhāremi antimam dehaṃ jetvā Māraṃ savāhanaṃ. // //
tha-ap19:11.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap19:12.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Upaseno Vaṅgantaputto thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
